description: GEO-09 spatial insights: design challenge and exact-diff review

reidentification.instructions: A released or stored aggregate could reveal a small group or an individual: a person-derived count below the minimum cohort, a value derivable from totals or complementary cells, a missingness count, a ratio exposing a suppressed numerator, or a grid fine enough to locate a home.

criteria.false: Small cells, complements, missingness and ratios are suppressed; the grid is coarse; the database refuses unsuppressed small counts

raw_location_leak.instructions: A raw coordinate, patient dot, subject reference or event id could reach an output, export, dashboard or stored row.

criteria.true: Some raw location or subject identifier can leak
criteria.false: Outputs and storage carry coarse cell ids and counts only

scope_leak.instructions: Events or aggregates of another tenant or branch could be mixed into, or read from, a tenant's insight, or a foreign event could be silently dropped instead of failing closed.

criteria.true: Some cross-scope mixing or silent filtering exists
criteria.false: Foreign events fail closed and RLS isolates storage

metric_ungoverned.instructions: A metric could be computed or stored without numerator/denominator, source, purpose, time window, aggregation, suppression threshold, missingness or retention, or a sensitive-intent metric could use the ordinary threshold.

criteria.true: Some required metric governance can be missing or weakened
criteria.false: Every metric definition is complete and validated, sensitive metrics are stricter

unstable_aggregation.instructions: The same events could produce different outputs depending on order or duplicates, or recomputation could store conflicting values for the same cell and window.

criteria.false: Deterministic, order-independent, duplicate-safe, one row per cell per window

untested_requirement.instructions: A handoff-required behaviour (low-count suppression, cross-tenant isolation, no patient dots, no raw-coordinate dashboard export, stable aggregation) has no planned or implemented test.

criteria.false: Every required behaviour has a TypeScript or smoke test
